description: Push notifications: the daily check-in reminder (services/checkinReminders.js) and the bell's notifications by group, Market, Bets, Social and Exchange (services/pushNotifications.js). Covers the Settings page's Notifications section, the account menu's Settings link, GET/PUT /api/settings/notifications and its push-device endpoints (404 without the flag), and the pushes themselves (at "staff" only admins get any). Push also needs the WEB_PUSH_* secrets; without them the section says push isn't available. The Settings page itself (/settings), the More sheet link and the profile link also show with the timezone-setting flag (its Display section).
